name: FPV T13b Rescue Low Sats Failsafe

metadata.description: Validation test for the GPS Rescue LOWSATS check (docs/fpv-hud-gnss-test-plan.md, T13b): the link is lost at 19 s (GPS-RESCUE procedure); satellites drop to 2 at 27 s, in FLY_HOME. After 10 s of 1 Hz checks the rescue fails with LOWSATS: with the link lost the FS_ONLY policy aborts and disarms at once.
